title: @kirigami/plugin-clip options
description: Options for the `@kirigami/plugin-clip` entry under `plugins:` in kirigami.yaml.

style.description: Append the default `.clip` card styles to every sass task. Set false to write your own on top of the markup.

posterWidth.description: Width, in pixels, of the poster picked from the video (height follows the video's aspect ratio). Published through the image pipeline in the project's `image.format`.

samples.description: How many timestamps bestframe samples across the video when picking the poster. More is slower to build (results are cached).
